result.summary: The page is generally visually polished, but the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next restaurant card, and several horizontal carousels are visibly clipped at the right edge without an obvious scroll cue.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second restaurant card, hiding its image/content and making the page appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the page can scroll the card fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chips and “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel extend beyond the right viewport edge, leaving partially visible items and truncated text.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intentional, add a subtle scroll affordance or ensure clipping is visually consistent; otherwise make the items responsive to the viewport width.
